summary: Root cause of ~3/poll: serial single-task ClaimTask per round-trip + full 30s PollInterval nap on first transient task==nil mid-burst + lossy/coalescing per-runtime wakeup (signalTaskWakeup non-blocking send drops signals fired while poller busy) -> nap not interrupted; single-agent burst serial through one poller. Fix design: (1) level-triggered generation-counter wakeup (lossless), (2) bounded drainRuntimeQueue up to cap(sem) with non-blocking slot acquire (backpressure) + loop re-drain only on generation advance (no busy-loop, no unbounded launches), (3) optional batch ClaimTasks(limit=freeSlots) throughput boost (server/client/SQL handoff). Cancel/backpressure/auto-update-barrier/tier-gate preserved. Exact diff points + focused tests. Live 20-drain still gated.
validation: design-only, no edits (git diff --check CLEAN). Root cause verified by reading runRuntimePoller (daemon.go:2557), waitForTaskSlot, capacityBackoff, newTaskSlotSemaphore, signalTaskWakeup (wakeup.go:321 non-blocking send=lossy), sleepWithContextOrWakeup, config (PollInterval=30s, MaxConcurrentTasks=20).
